To summarize, the key findings of our research, stated in one sentence that includes all relevant information, are that
AP‐1 transcription factor c‐Jun interacts with histone acetytransferase p300, and together with its dimerization partner, c‐FOS, stimulates Pol III‐dependent expression of 5S and U6 genes.
AP‐1 transcriptional factors stimulate the expression of Pol III‐regulated 5S rRNAs and U6 snRNAs via p300 recruitment and histone acetylations.
the c‐Jun/AP‐1 transcription factors bind to the promoters of Pol III‐transcribed genes, and promote Pol III transcription via chromatin remodeling and histone acetylations.
In summary, our research is concerned with
the identification of AP‐1 factors as novel Pol III transcription regulators and their potential role in cell growth and proliferation.
the role of transcription factors in the regulation of Pol III‐mediated transcription of non‐coding RNAs.
the role of AP‐1 factors in the transcription of 5S ribosome and U6 snRNAs, two noncoding RNAs that are involved in ribosome biogenesis and RNA processing.
In summary, a comprehensive and detailed conclusive statement would be that
c‐FOS and c‐JUN are novel regulators of RNA polymerase III‐driven transcription.
AP‐1 transcriptional complex regulates Pol III‐dependent gene expression by recruiting histone acetylase complex and chromatin remodeling factors.
AP‐1‐dependent activation of Pol III transcription is a new mechanism of cell cycle regulation.
A comprehensive summary for our work would be that

the c‐Jun and c‐Fos transcription factors bind to specific sites within the regulatory regions of the 5S rDNA and U6 snDNA and stimulate their transcription by facilitating Pol III recruitment via histone acetyl transferase p300.
AP‐1‐dependent Pol III transcription is a mechanism for cell proliferation and growth.
the AP‐1 transcription factor c‐Jun, in collaboration with the histone acetyl transferase p300, activates transcription from Pol III promoters.
The main takeaway from our work is that
AP‐1 proteins are novel transcription factors that regulate Pol III‐drived 5S rDNA and U6 snDNA transcription.
AP‐1 transcription factor c‐Jun, in association with histone acetylator p300/CBP, is a novel activator of RNA polymerase III‐dependent 55 rRNA and U16 snRNA gene expression.
the AP‐1 factors c‐Fos/c‐Jun, which were originally characterized as regulators of cell cycle progression, are novel regulators of RNA Pol III‐driving 5S rDNA and U6 snDNA gene expression.
